questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Multi-Environment Deployment?
options: Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Multi-environment delivery promotes the same tested artifact from development to staging to production using distinct configuration and approval gates.
questions.answer_key: Multi-environment delivery promotes the same tested artifact from development to staging to production using distinct configuration and approval gates.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of multi-environment deployment: Multi-environment delivery promotes the same tested artifact from development to staging to production using distinct configuration and approval gates. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.answer_key: Use filters to reduce unnecessary runs only when skipped work is genuinely unrelated. Include shared dependencies and test the changed and unchanged path cases so required checks are not bypassed.
questions.explanation: Development to staging to production: Use filters to reduce unnecessary runs only when skipped work is genuinely unrelated. questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to multi-environment deployment?
options: Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: Multi-environment delivery promotes the same tested artifact from development to staging to production using distinct configuration and approval gates. A syntax check alone cannot prove remote execution, permissions, or deployment behavior.
